faq.q: What is the origin of Jawahir?
faq.a: Jawahir is associated with Arabic. Jawahir is Arabic جَوَاهِر (Jawāhir) 'jewels, gems, precious stones', the plural of جَوْهَر (jawhar). The source gloss 'Pearls' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as jawahar, jawaher, jawhar and johar.
